summary: Full end-to-end validation of the new 'A Minha Meta' premium feature (backend + frontend). All 6 pytest backend tests pass (deterministic math verified: annualized=240000, revenue pct=48%, needed_per_year=333333, 3 milestones for years 2027-2029; deadline-by-date computes years_left correctly; on-demand /goal/plan returns valid AI plan; premium gating returns 402 for free users). UI verified: admin sees nav-meta, /meta loads, form saves, snapshot + value-goal-card + revenue-goal-card render with correct numbers, plan is NOT auto-generated, generate-plan-btn produces ceo-plan block with verdict/diagnostic/actions/phrase, persistence works after reload, deadline-by-date reflects in years-left. Free user sees UpgradeWall on /meta and nav-meta shows the lock icon (gated).
critical_code_review_comments: goals.py _compute_goal uses aod.month for months_elapsed but ignores year — if user picks ytd_as_of in a past/future year it silently uses just the month. Consider clamping to current year or documenting.

Plan cache is invalidated on save (delete_many ai_cache kind=goal_plan) which is correct; however GET /goal/plan is only POST — that's fine but note it will consume LLM tokens on every explicit click after re-save (by design).
